Question1.Question: Which fuel type showed the highest growth rate from 2023 to 2024?
Question1.SQL_Query:
WITH fuel_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        v.fuel_type,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.year_report = 2023 THEN f.vehicle_count ELSE 0 END) AS registrations_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.year_report = 2024 THEN f.vehicle_count ELSE 0 END) AS registrations_2024
    FROM FactRegisteredVehicles f
    JOIN DimTime t ON f.time_key = t.time_key
    JOIN DimVehicle v ON f.vehicle_key = v.vehicle_key
    WHERE t.year_report IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY v.fuel_type
), growth_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        fuel_type,
        registrations_2024,
        registrations_2023,
        (registrations_2024 - registrations_2023) * 1.0 / NULLIF(registrations_2023, 0) AS growth
    FROM fuel_growth
)
SELECT fuel_type, growth
FROM growth_rate
ORDER BY growth DESC
LIMIT 1;

Question2.Question: What is the growth rate among body types from 2023 to 2024?
Question2.SQL_Query:
WITH registrations AS (
    SELECT 
        v.body_type,
        t.year_report,
        SUM(f.vehicle_count) AS total_registrations
    FROM FactRegisteredVehicles f
    JOIN DimVehicle v ON f.vehicle_key = v.vehicle_key
    JOIN DimTime t ON f.time_key = t.time_key
    WHERE t.year_report IN (2023, 2024) 
    GROUP BY v.body_type, t.year_report
)
SELECT 
    r2023.body_type,
    r2023.total_registrations AS registrations_2023,
    r2024.total_registrations AS registrations_2024,
    ((r2024.total_registrations - r2023.total_registrations) * 100.0 / r2023.total_registrations) AS growth_rate
FROM 
    (SELECT body_type, total_registrations FROM registrations WHERE year_report = 2023) r2023
JOIN 
    (SELECT body_type, total_registrations FROM registrations WHERE year_report = 2024) r2024
ON r2023.body_type = r2024.body_type;
